about_the_game:
Light & Claw is a top-down 3D action RPG with a rare twist — the protagonist is a transforming healer.

You play as a White Mage who supports allies with powerful healing and protective magic, but in moments of crisis can transform into a mighty white tiger warrior, wielding heavy weapons to crush enemies head-on.

Victory hinges on your ability to adapt: master a variety of healing and support spells, time your heals precisely, and unleash your transformation at just the right moment to turn the tide of battle.

Explore intricate labyrinths, face formidable foes, and discover a combat system where healing is as vital as striking, and where the line between mage and warrior is yours to command.
detailed_description:
Development Update – Demo Release Delay

Hello everyone,

Our initial plan was to release the demo on September 15th, but during development I encountered many bugs and unfinished parts that still need extra polish. In order to deliver the quality experience this game deserves, I’ve decided to delay the demo release and spend more time optimizing and improving it.

I hope you can understand this decision and continue to follow the project. Your patience and support mean a lot, and I’ll make sure the demo is worth the wait!
